description: Custom React hook 'useLogin' for handling rider login, including form validation, API mutations, notification permissions, and token management.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates that username and password are not empty, sets error messages accordingly.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful login mutation, stores token, and manages last order credentials.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during login mutation, logs error, and shows message.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Validates form, requests notification permissions, retrieves notification token, and triggers login mutation.
